subject: french
title: Other French Voices
welcome_lead: Beyond Camus and Sartre, HL options include Annie Ernaux, Marguerite Duras, Aime Cesaire. Each offers a different French.
meta_desc: French HL Literature: Ernaux, Duras, Cesaire as further options.
final_note: The French canon widens with each generation.

concepts.def: Nobel laureate 2022, writer of autobiographical sociology.
Cahier d'un retour au pays natal (1939), Cesaire's foundational poem.

walkthroughs.body_html: Ernaux blends memoir with sociology. La Place (1983) examines her father's working-class life. Her plain style is itself a politics.
Set in colonial Indochina, the novel mixes desire and memory. The narrator's first-person shifts to third — destabilising identity.
Cahier d'un retour au pays natal launches Negritude. Cesaire's surrealist French becomes a weapon against colonialism.
